SELECT
    a.FMID,
    NVL(a.FMOPCODE, b.FMOPCODE) AS FMOPCODE,
    NVL(a.FMNAME, b.FMNAME) AS FMNAME,
    NVL(a.FMSIGN, b.FMSIGN) AS FMSIGN,
    NVL(a.FMUNIT, b.FMUNIT) AS FMUNIT,
    NVL(a.FMRATE, b.FMRATE) AS FMRATE,
    a.USESTATUS,
    a.DELETED,
    a.CREATE_TIME,
    a.UPDATE_TIME,
    a.CREATE_BY,
    a.UPDATE_BY
FROM T_COST_FORMONEY a
LEFT JOIN pub_formoney_v@hyerp b ON a.FMID = b.FMID
WHERE a.DELETED = 0 OR a.DELETED IS NULL

SELECT GOODSID,
       GOODSNAME,
       PRICE,
       USEFLAG,
       GOODSTYPE,
       PACKTYPE,
       FACTORYNAME,
       DELETED,
       CREATE_TIME,
       UPDATE_TIME,
       CREATE_BY,
       UPDATE_BY,
       ISERP,
       CASE
           WHEN ISERP = 1
            AND UPDATE_BY <> 'ERP_SYNC'
            AND PRICE IS NULL THEN 'erp-price-null'
           WHEN ISERP = 1
            AND UPDATE_BY <> 'ERP_SYNC' THEN 'erp-updated'
           WHEN ISERP = 1 THEN 'erp'
           ELSE NULL
       END AS ROW_CLASS_FLAG,
       STANDARDTYPE,
       GOODSNAME_EN,
       decode(ZX_PRICE,null,price,ZX_PRICE)ZX_PRICE
  FROM T_COST_GOODS WHERE USEFLAG NOT IN ('产成品','半成品')

SELECT a.conid,
       a.goodsid,
       a.goodsname || '(' || a.packtype || ')' AS goodsgp,
       a.lotno,
       a.goodsno,
       b.packsize,
       TO_CHAR(NVL(b.goodsqty_total, 0)) || b.basepackname || '（含零头' ||
       TO_CHAR(NVL(b.goodsqty_oddtray1, 0)) || b.basepackname || '，样品__' ||
       b.basepackname || '）' AS QTY_SHOW,
       b.pcs,
       a.tranposname, 0 AS DELETED
  FROM (SELECT a.conid,
               a.goodsid,
               a.goodsno,
               a.goodsname,
               a.lotno,
               a.packtype,
               a.tranposname
          FROM bms_sa_con_dtl_v@hyerp a
         GROUP BY a.conid,
                  a.goodsid,
                  a.goodsno,
                  a.goodsname,
                  a.lotno,
                  a.packtype,a.tranposname) a,
(SELECT x.goodsownid,
        x.lotno,
        x.packname,
        x.basepackname,
        x.packsize,
        SUM(x.goodsqty) AS goodsqty_total,
        SUM(MOD(x.goodsqty, x.packsize)) AS goodsqty_oddtray1,
        SUM(CEIL(x.goodsqty / x.packsize)) AS pcs
 FROM wms_st_qty_lst_baseunit_v@to_wms x
 GROUP BY x.goodsownid, x.lotno, x.packname, x.packsize, x.basepackname) b

 WHERE a.goodsid = b.goodsownid
   AND a.lotno = b.lotno

SELECT a.CUSTOMID,
       a.CUSTOMNAME,
       a.ZONE AS COUNTRY,
       b.TRANPOSNAME AS LIVERY,
       b.TRANPOSID,
       0 AS DELETED
  FROM T_COST_CUSTOMER_V a, T_COST_TRANPOSER_V b
 WHERE a.CUSTOMID = b.CUSTOMID(+)

SELECT a.GOODSID,
       a.GOODSNAME,
       a.APPROVEDOCNO AS MA_NO,
       a.ZX_PL AS APEX_PL,
       a.HOLDERSNAME AS MAH,
       a.ZX_MINIMUM AS P_PERPACK,
       a.BASEUNITQTY AS S_PERBACK,
       a.ZX_CUSTOMERID AS CUSTOMID,
       a.CUSTOMNAME,
       CASE WHEN a.ISERP = 0 AND b.PGOODSID IS NULL THEN 'ERP未搭建BOM'
            ELSE 'ERP已搭建BOM' END AS MEMO,
       a.GOODSTYPE AS STRENGTH,
       a.TRANPOSNAME AS LIVERY,
       a.DELETED,a.goodsname_en
  FROM T_COST_GOODS_V a
  LEFT JOIN mpcs_pr_bom_doc@hyerp b ON a.GOODSID = b.PGOODSID AND b.USESTATUS = 1 AND a.ISERP = 1
 WHERE a.USEFLAG = '产成品'
   AND (a.DELETED = 0 OR a.DELETED IS NULL)

       b.factoryname,
